name: io.github.xka0085-byte/agenttoll-receipts
title: AgentToll Receipts
description: Issue and verify on-chain x402 delivery receipts on Solana. Hash-locked, escrow-grade, independently verifiable proof of delivery.

tools.name: issue_receipt
tools.title: Issue delivery receipt
tools.description: Anchor a SHA-256 digest of delivered content plus the x402 settlement reference on Solana. Returns a permanent, publicly verifiable receipt URI. Use after a successful x402 settlement to give the buyer proof of delivery. Costs 0.001 USDC via x402 (founding sellers free).

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.title: Verify delivery receipt
tools.description: Verify any AgentToll receipt against Solana state and return C1-C5 check results: contract match, deliverable match, tamper detection, timing, amount. Use before accepting a paid delivery as final. Read-only, no cost.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.title: Get receipt details
tools.description: Fetch full receipt details by receipt id: digests, checks, outcome (settled/refunded/expired), amount, buyer, seller, timestamp. Read-only, no cost.
